summary: Bunker Evolved is a generative ambient firmware forked from Felucca 1.6.1, built around worlds, motifs and controlled mutation, with Felucca's engine editors still available.
features: 64 sound recipes in four-role banks; 24 worlds and 24 motifs
32 scales and GROW scale variations with one-step undo
Seven bounded mutations plus a lock
Six HOME views editing the real synth and sequencer state
Four project slots; Felucca and AMB projects not migrated
Browser simulator and Chrome editor; runs on one CPU core
